title: Equil 5.4 battery and control issue
symptom: The user reports issues with the Equil pump: battery showing 0% and battery warnings, after changing battery the pump did not respond to commands, could not unpair or bolus, and after restarting phone could pair again but battery still 0%, then bolus failed on progress screen.
cause: The thread indicates that the pump firmware version is too old; the user needs firmware at least 5.3 (they meant 5.4).
fix: Update the pump firmware to at least version 5.3 (or 5.4 as clarified). Additionally, a fix for the battery report was committed and included in dev3.
